triggers: unresolved standing-pair disagreement or unclear settlement
standing pair cannot reach justified confidence
extra_family_review.rule: When a trigger fires, the host records a disposition: named Plan vN assignment plus returned evidence if the extra catalog family is available, or an evidenced limitation if it is not. Unknown availability does not discharge the duty. Named extra-family review is an assigned duty. Its output is evidence the host records. It does not replace either standing primary, does not settle Plan vN, and is never a silent third vote.
